component.name: Claude
component.summary: Desktop application for Claude with Code agent and MCP

description.p: Claude Desktop brings the intelligence of Anthropic's Claude models directly to your desktop with deep developer workflows, Model Context Protocol (MCP) connectors, and native agentic coding capabilities.
The integrated Code tab allows you to run parallel autonomous coding sessions with Git isolation, visual side-by-side diff reviews, live app browser previews, and integrated terminal execution.
